package parsers

import (
	"fmt"
	"net/http"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/filters"
	"github.com/go-playground/validator/v10"
)

// ParseTrackFilters parses track filters from query parameters.
func ParseTrackFilters(r *http.Request, validator *validator.Validate) (filters.TrackFilters, error) {
	var result filters.TrackFilters
	var err error
	if result.ID, err = parseStringParam(r, "id", validator, "uuid"); err != nil {
		return filters.TrackFilters{}, err
	}
	if result.Slug, err = parseStringParam(r, "slug", validator, "ascii,max=255"); err != nil {
		return filters.TrackFilters{}, err
	}
	statusRule := fmt.Sprintf("oneof=%d %d", domain.CatalogStatusNoActive, domain.CatalogStatusActive)
	if result.Status, err = parseIntParam(r, "status", validator, statusRule); err != nil {
		return filters.TrackFilters{}, err
	}
	if result.Title, err = parseStringParam(r, "title", validator, "max=255"); err != nil {
		return filters.TrackFilters{}, err
	}
	return result, nil
}

// ParseCourseLevelFilters parses course level filters from query parameters.
func ParseCourseLevelFilters(r *http.Request, validator *validator.Validate) (filters.CourseLevelFilters, error) {
	var result filters.CourseLevelFilters
	var err error
	if result.ID, err = parseStringParam(r, "id", validator, "uuid"); err != nil {
		return filters.CourseLevelFilters{}, err
	}
	if result.Slug, err = parseStringParam(r, "slug", validator, "ascii,max=255"); err != nil {
		return filters.CourseLevelFilters{}, err
	}
	if result.TrackID, err = parseStringParam(r, "track_id", validator, "uuid"); err != nil {
		return filters.CourseLevelFilters{}, err
	}
	statusRule := fmt.Sprintf("oneof=%d %d", domain.CatalogStatusNoActive, domain.CatalogStatusActive)
	if result.Status, err = parseIntParam(r, "status", validator, statusRule); err != nil {
		return filters.CourseLevelFilters{}, err
	}
	if result.Title, err = parseStringParam(r, "title", validator, "max=255"); err != nil {
		return filters.CourseLevelFilters{}, err
	}
	return result, nil
}

// ParseCourseGroupFilters parses course group filters from query parameters.
func ParseCourseGroupFilters(r *http.Request, validator *validator.Validate) (filters.CourseGroupFilters, error) {
	var result filters.CourseGroupFilters
	var err error
	if result.ID, err = parseStringParam(r, "id", validator, "uuid"); err != nil {
		return filters.CourseGroupFilters{}, err
	}
	if result.Slug, err = parseStringParam(r, "slug", validator, "ascii,max=255"); err != nil {
		return filters.CourseGroupFilters{}, err
	}
	if result.LevelID, err = parseStringParam(r, "level_id", validator, "uuid"); err != nil {
		return filters.CourseGroupFilters{}, err
	}
	statusRule := fmt.Sprintf("oneof=%d %d", domain.CatalogStatusNoActive, domain.CatalogStatusActive)
	if result.Status, err = parseIntParam(r, "status", validator, statusRule); err != nil {
		return filters.CourseGroupFilters{}, err
	}
	if result.Title, err = parseStringParam(r, "title", validator, "max=255"); err != nil {
		return filters.CourseGroupFilters{}, err
	}
	return result, nil
}
